purpose.description: Identify useful boundary cases before writing tests for a synthetic discount function; return concrete cases and expected outcomes.
purpose.deliverable: Boundary-case test list for the current discount-function implementation

payload.input: For a synthetic function final_price(price, discount) = max(0, price - discount), propose a concise set of boundary tests. Assume finite nonnegative decimal inputs. Include expected values and explain any behavior that needs an explicit product decision.
